purpose: Destructive blind test for the refined candidate that 060-920 is a broader terminal cap, not merely a 741-060-920 visual formula.

promotion_rule: The broad 060-920 cap strengthens only if blind readers recover a recurring terminal visual cluster in positive panels at a higher rate than 060-non920 controls.
